problem: Exact-main Netlify production and pricing content were green, but the production browser had zero mobile language selects. Direct live HTML inspection proved that /prijzen contained the i18n stylesheet marker while the required /assets/js/i18n.js runtime script was absent.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs used one generic data-bg-i18n-asset marker as a completeness test. Because pricing already contained the CSS asset marker, the transformer returned early and skipped both the missing runtime script injection and the mobile language-control injection. The browser therefore had no runtime capable of mounting any language selector.
prevention: Treat each mandatory i18n asset independently: stylesheet, runtime script, static locale routes and active mobile language control.
Never use one shared marker as proof that a multi-asset runtime contract is complete.
Build transforms must be idempotent and inject only missing assets without early-returning on partial state.
Validate final served production HTML for both i18n.css and i18n.js.
Validate the active production mobile navigation contains exactly one visible language selector.
Require NL->EN /en/prijzen -> NL /prijzen browser roundtrip with correct html lang and no visible switching error before LIVE_BEWEZEN.
Persist refined root causes as new canonical learning instead of deleting earlier incident evidence.

evidence.browser_failure: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation

evaluation.expected_invariant: final production HTML contains both i18n.css and i18n.js, the active mobile host exposes one visible language select, and NL->EN->NL roundtrip succeeds
